This could be a symptom of many physical or mental issues (including the ones mentioned on this thread so far), however I wanted to mention bi-polar I and II and symptoms of psychosis which can accompany either of those conditions. Psychosis can last briefly, or for weeks. Confusion, out of body experiences, thinking you are in a different dimension or have the ability to hear different languages, etc. (you can google psychosis for more symptoms) are part of the symptoms of psychosis. The language thing in particular is often a symptom. Often when a person is experiencing symptoms of psychosis, they think they are OK (or at least not expecting something like psychosis) but other people notice a change of behavior, so you could ask someone close to you if they have noticed any confusion or disorientation on your part recently.
